_doc: AIR (2026-11-06, docs/ai-ranking-2026-11-05, package P6): the Content Cadence's AI-ranking rules, one file for both sides: the engine harness runs every case through the real Cadence Plan node (harness/scenarios_air_exec.js AE1 / AE2) and the app mirror (app/server/src/services/cadence.ts, app/server/test/airCadence.test.ts) runs the same cases. Synthetic data only. Format = harness/fixtures/cadence_levels.json (tables, trigger, now, level, expect) plus: tables.air_cache = seo_cache rows of kind 'air' (the kill switch, the protect lists), seo_monitors.ai_rank_mode / ai_rank_reserve, seo_ai_targets.origin / action_id. expect.air = null when the plan must carry no `air` key (off, shadow, killed), else { reserved: keyword | null, honoured: [keyword], protected: [keyword] }. expect.same_as names a keyword-first case whose expectation an off / shadow / killed case must equal.
